beats: Every sentence played at the same fixed speed — too fast to catch, or too slow to bear.
Advanced learners sat through needless repeats; beginners never caught the fast phrase.
So playback became a ladder: slow, then normal, then fast, all in one pass.
A Python script now builds that ladder, giving grammar a real time budget instead of a flat guess.
Now the learner hears slow, normal and fast in one pass — three speeds where there used to be one.
